ei.title: 10강 Challenge 01 — 반려동물이 이끈 극적인 치료 반응
ei.subject: 이투스유형독해S

fullPassage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showed a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with whom it could ①<u>communicate</u>, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ②<u>ranged</u> from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were ③<u>offered</u> as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven ④<u>adopted</u> them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showed a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② ranged → ranging: 명사 patients를 뒤에서 꾸미며 '~에 이르는'이라는 능동의 뜻이므로 현재분사 ranging이 맞아요.
det.analysis:
① communicate: 'a pet with whom it could communicate(함께 소통할 수 있는 반려동물)'에서 조동사 could 뒤에 동사원형이 와서 맞아요.

② ranged → ranging: 'with patients ranged from adolescents to the old and infirm'에서 patients를 꾸며 주는 분사 자리예요. 환자들이 '~에 걸쳐 있는'이라는 능동 의미라 현재분사 ranging을 써야 하는데 과거분사처럼 보이는 ranged를 쓰면 틀려요. ← 정답

③ offered: 'dogs ... who were offered as pets(반려동물로 제공된 개들)'는 who were + 과거분사의 수동 관계절이라 offered가 맞아요.

④ adopted: 'the other forty-seven adopted them(나머지 47명이 그들을 받아들였다)'에서 과거 동사로 맞아요.
det.tip: 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미며 능동이면 현재분사(-ing). patients ranging from A to B = A부터 B까지 이르는 환자들.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been ①<u>saved</u> by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have ②<u>conducted</u> some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who ③<u>have failed</u> to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showed a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years ④<u>began</u> to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ have failed → had failed: 글 전체가 과거 시제이고, 개를 데려온 것보다 '먼저' 반응하지 못한 일이므로 과거완료 had failed가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
① saved: 'the mental health of a child has been saved(아이의 정신 건강이 지켜져 왔다)'는 has been + 과거분사의 현재완료 수동태라 맞아요.

② conducted: 'have conducted some interesting experiments(흥미로운 실험을 수행했다)'는 have + 과거분사의 현재완료라 맞아요.

③ have failed → had failed: 'patients who have failed to respond'에서, 뒤 문장(brought in dogs)이 과거이고 환자들이 반응하지 못한 것은 그보다 더 앞선 일이에요. 과거의 특정 시점보다 먼저 일어난 일은 과거완료(had + 과거분사) had failed로 써야 하는데 현재완료 have failed를 쓰면 시제가 어긋나요. ← 정답

④ began: 'One man ... began to speak(한 남자가 말하기 시작했다)'에서 과거 동사로 맞아요.
det.tip: 과거보다 더 앞선 일은 과거완료(had + p.p.). 여기선 had failed.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with ①<u>whom</u> it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients ②<u>refused</u> to ③<u>accept</u> the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset ④<u>showing</u> a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ showing → showed: 앞의 과거 동사 adopted와 and로 연결되는 병렬 자리라 과거형 showed가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
① whom: 'a pet with whom it could communicate'에서 전치사 with의 목적어인 관계대명사 whom으로 맞아요.

② refused: 'Only three of the fifty patients refused(오직 세 명만 거부했다)'에서 과거 동사로 맞아요.

③ accept: 'refused to accept the dogs(개를 받아들이기를 거부했다)'에서 refuse의 목적어인 to부정사라 accept가 맞아요.

④ showing → showed: 'the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showing a striking improvement'에서 and는 앞의 과거 동사 adopted와 병렬을 이뤄요. 따라서 뒤도 과거 동사 showed여야 하는데 showing(현재분사)을 쓰면 본동사가 사라져 병렬이 깨져요. ← 정답
det.tip: A and B 병렬은 형태를 맞춰요. 주어(forty-seven)의 동사 adopted와 showed가 짝이에요.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been ①<u>harmed</u> by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have ②<u>conducted</u> some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①은 원문이 '지켜졌다(saved)'인데 '해를 입었다(harmed)'로 바꾸면, 반려동물이 아이를 도왔다는 문맥과 정반대가 돼요.
det.analysis:
① harmed(해를 입은) → saved(지켜진): 원문은 사람이 소통해 주지 못하는 상황에서 반려동물 덕분에 아이의 정신 건강이 '지켜졌다'는 뜻이에요. harmed(해를 입은)로 바꾸면 반려동물이 아이를 해쳤다는 정반대 의미가 되어 뒤 내용과 모순돼요. ← 정답

② conducted(수행했다): 연구진이 실험을 수행했다는 문맥에 적절해요.

③ refused(거부했다): 3명만 개를 거부했다는 문맥에 적절해요.

④ striking(뚜렷한): 개를 받아들인 환자들이 뚜렷한 향상을 보였다는 문맥에 적절해요.
det.tip: saved(지켜진) ↔ harmed(해를 입은). 반려동물이 아이의 정신 건강을 지킨 맥락이에요.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally ①<u>abusive</u> home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters ②<u>selected</u> patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showed a ③<u>minor</u> improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years ④<u>began</u> to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③은 원문이 '뚜렷한(striking)'인데 '사소한(minor)'으로 바꾸면, 반응이 '극적'이었다는 앞 내용과 어긋나요.
det.analysis:
① abusive(학대하는): 사람이 소통해 주지 못하는 정서적으로 '학대하는' 가정이라는 문맥에 적절해요.

② selected(선정했다): 실험자들이 환자를 골랐다는 문맥에 적절해요.

③ minor(사소한) → striking(뚜렷한): 바로 앞에서 'The responses were dramatic(반응이 극적이었다)'라고 했고, 26년간 말 없던 남자가 말하기 시작한 사례가 이어져요. 따라서 향상은 '뚜렷한(striking)' 것이어야 하며 minor(사소한)로 바꾸면 모순돼요. ← 정답

④ began(시작했다): 말 없던 남자가 말하기 시작했다는 문맥에 적절해요.
det.tip: responses were dramatic(극적 반응)이 단서. 향상은 minor(사소한)가 아니라 striking(뚜렷한)이에요.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and __________ showed a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 47명은 개를 열의로 받아들였고 '처음부터' 뚜렷한 향상을 보였다.
det.analysis:
① against all odds(모든 역경을 딛고): 향상의 '시점'을 설명하는 자리와 어울리지 않아요.

② from the outset(처음부터): 'adopted them with enthusiasm(열의로 받아들였다)'과 이어지고, 곧바로 뚜렷한 향상을 보였다는 흐름이므로 '처음부터'가 정확히 맞아요. ← 정답

③ in the long run(장기적으로): '처음부터 곧'이라는 즉각성과 반대되는 표현이에요.

④ by pure chance(순전히 우연으로): 실험의 인과적 효과를 설명하는 문맥과 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: outset = 시작. from the outset = 처음부터. 개를 받자마자 곧바로 좋아졌다는 뜻이에요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 50명 중 오직 3명만 개를 반려동물로 '받아들이기를 거부했다'.
det.analysis:
① refused to accept(받아들이기를 거부했다): 바로 뒤 'but the other forty-seven adopted them(그러나 나머지 47명은 받아들였다)'과 역접(but)으로 대비되므로, 3명은 '거부'해야 자연스러워요. ← 정답

② were quick to adopt(재빨리 받아들였다): 뒤의 '나머지 47명은 받아들였다'와 대비가 사라져 but과 어울리지 않아요.

③ asked to train(훈련을 요청했다): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.

④ learned to feed(먹이 주는 법을 배웠다): 개 수용 여부를 다루는 문맥과 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: 역접 but이 단서. 3명은 거부(refused), 47명은 수용(adopted)의 대비예요.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 가정·연구 주체·환자 수·연령대에 관한 세부 내용
det.analysis:
① 학대 가정에서 반려동물이 아이를 지킴: 'the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet'와 일치해요.

② 오하이오 주립대 연구진 수행: 'Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University'와 일치해요.

③ 50명 중 47명이 개를 열의로 받아들임: 'the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm'과 일치해요.

④ 오직 노인 환자만 대상: 본문은 'patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm(청소년부터 노약자까지)'라고 했으므로 '노인만'은 사실이 아니에요. ← 정답(일치하지 않음)
det.tip: ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm = 청소년부터 노약자까지. '노인만'은 틀려요.

ch: 정서적으로 학대하는 가정에서도 반려동물이 아이의 정신 건강을 지킨 경우가 있다.
이 연구는 오하이오 주립대 정신의학과의 연구진에 의해 수행되었다.
50명의 환자 중 47명이 개를 열의를 가지고 받아들였다.
실험은 오직 노인 환자만을 대상으로 진행되었다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 견종·환자 반응·치료 효과에 관한 세부 내용
det.analysis:
① 개들이 모두 같은 한 품종: 'dogs of various breeds(여러 품종의 개)'와 모순돼요.

② 대부분의 환자가 거부: 'Only three ... refused ... but the other forty-seven adopted'로 보아 대부분은 받아들였으므로 틀려요.

③ 기존 치료에 반응하지 못하던 환자들이 개를 통해 호전: 'patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy'가 'from the outset showed a striking improvement'로 이어지므로 일치해요. ← 정답

④ 실험 후에도 말을 하지 못함: 'began to speak(말하기 시작했다)'와 모순돼요.
det.tip: failed to respond ... showed a striking improvement = 기존 치료가 안 듣던 환자가 개로 호전됨.

ch: 실험에 사용된 개들은 모두 같은 한 품종이었다.
대부분의 환자는 개를 반려동물로 받아들이기를 거부했다.
기존 치료에 반응하지 못하던 환자들이 개를 통해 호전을 보였다.
26년간 말이 없던 남자는 실험 후에도 끝내 말을 하지 못했다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 반려동물의 역할·환자 선정·호전 시점·실험 결과에 관한 세부 내용
det.analysis:
① 사람이 해 주지 못한 소통을 반려동물이 제공: 'a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not(사람은 해 주지 못한 소통을 반려동물과 함께 함)'과 일치해요. ← 정답

② 이미 회복한 환자 선정: 'patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy(치료에 반응하지 못한 환자)'와 모순돼요.

③ 한참 지난 뒤 호전: 'from the outset showed a striking improvement(처음부터 호전)'와 모순돼요.

④ 효과가 없었다고 결론: 'The responses were dramatic'과 호전 사례로 보아 효과가 있었으므로 틀려요.
det.tip: human beings who could not = 사람은 (소통을) 해 주지 못함. 그 자리를 반려동물이 채웠어요.

ch: 반려동물은 사람이 해 주지 못한 소통을 아이에게 제공했다.

questions.passage: There can be little doubt that in many an emotionally abusive home, the mental health of a child has been saved by the presence of a pet with whom it could communicate, in the physical presence of human beings who could not. In this context, Drs. Samuel and Elizabeth Corson and their colleagues in the Department of Psychiatry at Ohio State University have conducted some interesting experiments in custodial institutions with patients ranging from adolescents to the old and infirm. The experimenters selected patients who had failed to respond to the traditional forms of therapy and brought in dogs of various breeds who were offered as pets to the patients. The responses were dramatic. Only three of the fifty patients refused to accept the dogs as pets, but the other forty-seven adopted them with enthusiasm, and from the outset showed a striking improvement. One man who had not spoken for twenty-six years began to speak.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재를 묻는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
① the difficulty of training various dog breeds(여러 견종을 훈련하는 어려움): 개 훈련은 본문에 없어요.

② the healing power of pets for those isolated from human contact(사람과의 접촉에서 단절된 이들에게 반려동물이 지닌 치유의 힘): 학대 가정 아이와 기존 치료가 안 듣던 환자 모두 반려동물로 호전되었다는 글 전체를 아울러요. ← 정답

③ the superiority of traditional medical therapy(전통 의학 치료의 우수성): 본문은 전통 치료에 '반응하지 못한' 환자를 다루므로 반대예요.

④ the ethical problems of animal experiments(동물 실험의 윤리적 문제): 윤리 문제는 언급되지 않았어요.
det.tip: 반복되는 pet(반려동물)과 saved·improvement(구원·향상)이 '반려동물의 치유력'이라는 주제를 가리켜요.

det.korean: 밑줄 친 대명사 them이 가리키는 대상을 찾는 문제예요.

① 50명의 환자들: 문장의 주어는 '나머지 47명(the other forty-seven)'이고, 그들이 받아들인 대상이 them이므로 환자 자신을 가리키지 않아요.
